lines.text: Accept the weak in faith, and the one who abstains must not judge the eater, for God has accepted him.
One person regards a certain day above the others, and whoever observes a special day does so to the Lord.
Let us stop judging one another; if what you eat distresses your brother, you are no longer acting in love.
All food is clean, yet better not to eat fish or drink wine if it causes your brother to stumble.
